description: A mythic-rare deep-wild owl — the rare apex nocturnal bird predator of the Feywood. Hollowcrown owls read the Feywood's ambient field and appear at disturbance edges before disturbances are visible. Occasional sightings beyond the Feywood are reported; elves treat realm-side Hollowcrown sightings as significant omens regardless of distance.

ecology.cultural_role: reads ambient field; appears at disturbance edges before disturbances are visible

name: Hollowcrown Owl
